messages.when: The user clicks Ask in chat in the tooltip, and x is a time
messages.message: Explain the value <y> of <series> <labels> (query <refId>) at the time <x> (<xIso>) in the chart <chart>, from <from> to <to>.

messages.when: The user clicks Ask in chat in the tooltip, and x is a number
messages.message: Explain the value <y> of <series> <labels> (query <refId>) at the x value <x> in the chart <chart>, from <from> to <to>.

messages.when: The user clicks Ask in chat in the tooltip, and x is a category
messages.message: Explain the value <y> of <series> <labels> (query <refId>) for the category <x> in the chart <chart>, from <from> to <to>.

messages.when: The Host answers the call of save_chart from the App with a JSON-RPC error, and the user sends the save to the chat
messages.message: Save this chart to a dashboard. Call save_chart with the arguments below. If you do not have the save_chart tool, do not save the chart with another tool, and tell me that save is not available. Arguments: <arguments>
